registration.who_may_register: Homeowner/customer or a person registering on the homeowner/customer's behalf; the official registration form shows both roles.

registration.terms_allow_third_party_preparation: uncertain - please check; the portal permits a representative role, but Daikin's site terms prohibit automated systems from monitoring or copying its sites. No automated portal access is enabled.
